parsed.rationale: Localized poison ivy contact dermatitis on forearms without fever, breathing difficulty, facial/genital involvement, or signs of infection; manageable with OTC hydrocortisone, calamine, oral antihistamines, cool compresses, and washing exposed skin/clothing. Escalate if rash spreads to face/eyes/genitals, becomes widespread, shows pus or worsening redness, or symptoms persist beyond 2-3 weeks.
